title: Life on Mars? — E-major Practice Accompaniment
tonalCenter: E major moving to A major
description: Independent high-G chord practice arrangement in the tutorial key. Chord qualities are reference-informed; bar lengths and rhythmic placement are approximate. Not Ben’s transcription or the original recording.
body:
Verse 1: E + Emaj7 | E7 + C#7sus4 | C#7 | F#m + A | D#dim + B7 | E + Emaj7 | E7 + C#7sus4 | C#7 | F#m + A | B9 + B7 | G + Gaug | Em + G7 | C + Caug | Am + C7
Chorus 1: A | D | F#m + Faug | E | Em | Bm7 + Dm | A | D | F#m + Faug | E | Em | Bm7 + Dm | F#m + Faug | A + B9
Interlude: E + Ddim | F#m + Gdim | G#m + Aadd2 | Am7 + E
Verse 2: E + Emaj7 | E7 + C#7sus4 | C#7 | F#m + A | D#dim + B7 | E + Emaj7 | E7 + C#7sus4 | C#7 | F#m + A | B9 + B7 | G + Gaug | Em + G7 | C + Caug | Am + C7
Chorus 2: A | D | F#m + Faug | E | Em | Bm7 + Dm | A | D | F#m + Faug | E | Em | Bm7 + Dm | F#m + Faug | A + B9
Outro: E + Ddim | F#m + Gdim | G#m + Aadd2 | Am7 + E
notes:
Practice reference: https://www.ukuleleroadtrips.com/learn-w-ben/life-on-mars-david-bowie
Generated chord voicings and independently assigned 4/4 practice durations; not exact tutorial shapes or melodic tabs. Ninth chords omit the fifth to fit four strings. Full bars use a quarter-note down/down/down/up exercise; two-chord bars use separate down/up strokes. Refer to the linked tutorial for exact rhythm, interlude melody and outro. F-major arrangement remains separate.
